topic: Vaccination uptake in immunosuppressed rheumatology patients

audits.title: P003 An audit of the uptake of vaccinations against influenza, pneumonia and varicella zoster among rheumatology outpatients
audits.standard: Public Health England, BSR and EULAR vaccination guidance; target 90% uptake; departmental vaccination advice in standard letter template
audits.setting: Rheumatology outpatient clinics, Salford Royal Hospital

cycle1.result: Influenza 63/87 (72%); pneumococcus 61/87 (70%); zoster 7/12 (64%); vaccination advice in 24/126 (19%) clinic letters.

audits.other_findings: 22 of 109 had no vaccination status in GP records. Planned: writing to patients about influenza vaccination, changing the letter template, and re-audit.
audits.citation: Kazi K, Low A. P003 An audit of the uptake of vaccinations against influenza, pneumonia and varicella zoster among rheumatology outpatients. Rheumatology. 2021;60(Supplement_1). doi:10.1093/rheumatology/keab247.002.

audits.title: P69 COVID vaccine uptake in young persons on immunosuppression under the care of tertiary paediatric rheumatology service
audits.standard: National guidance: immunocompromised 12–18-year-olds offered three primary Pfizer BioNTech doses 8 weeks apart plus a booster within 3 months
audits.setting: Tertiary paediatric rheumatology day-care and outpatient clinics

cycle1.result: 6/31 (19%) knew the correct regime (3 + 1); 18/31 (58%) had received the vaccine.

audits.other_findings: 9 (29%) unvaccinated were unsure if they needed it and 4 (13%) declined for personal beliefs; 4 refused further doses after side effects. Action plan includes documenting status at every contact, nurse education, default clinic letter text and re-audit in six months.
audits.citation: . P69 COVID vaccine uptake in young persons on immunosuppression under the care of tertiary paediatric rheumatology service. Rheumatol Adv Pract. 2022;6(Suppl 1).

audits.title: An audit of influenza and pneumococcal vaccination in rheumatology outpatients.
audits.standard: Influenza and pneumococcal vaccination recommendations for patients on immunosuppressant DMARDs
audits.setting: Hospital rheumatology outpatient clinics, Furness General Hospital

cycle1.result: Fewer patients on major immunosuppressants were vaccinated against influenza than those with additional clinical risk factors (53% vs 93%).

audits.other_findings: Awareness of immunisation was high but uptake suboptimal.
audits.citation: Sowden E, Mitchell WS. An audit of influenza and pneumococcal vaccination in rheumatology outpatients. BMC Musculoskelet Disord. 2007;8:58. doi:10.1186/1471-2474-8-58. PMID: 17610723.

audits.title: Rheumatologists fail to advise people with RA to get immunised, which matters if you are under 65: An audit in a New Zealand rheumatology service.
audits.standard: Guidelines for yearly influenza and five-yearly pneumococcal vaccination in rheumatoid arthritis

cycle1.period: One month after release of the 2015 influenza vaccine
cycle1.result: Documented immunisation advice was infrequent; exact figures not reported in the abstract.

audits.other_findings: Many patients were vaccinated despite little specialist advice, but rates were suboptimal, especially under 65.
audits.citation: Ng B, McBain L, Grainger R. Rheumatologists fail to advise people with RA to get immunised, which matters if you are under 65: An audit in a New Zealand rheumatology service. N Z Med J. 2016;129(1446):72-78. PMID: 27906921.

audits.title: A clinical audit of pneumococcal vaccination among patients with autoimmune rheumatic diseases living in Greece: The power of awareness.
audits.standard: National guidelines for pneumococcal vaccination in autoimmune rheumatic diseases
audits.setting: Outpatient clinic, Laikon General Hospital, Athens

cycle1.result: Pneumococcal vaccination rate 49.37%; 45.06% vaccinated in last five years; only 8.21% had a second vaccine as per national guidelines.

audits.other_findings: Age over 65 influenced vaccination; physician recommendation and patient understanding were thought to improve uptake.
audits.citation: Constantinou CA, Ziogas DC, Venetsanopoulou A, Gamaletsou MN, Koutsogeorgopoulou L, Barbouni A, et al.. A clinical audit of pneumococcal vaccination among patients with autoimmune rheumatic diseases living in Greece: The power of awareness. Vaccine. 2021;39(11):1593-1597. doi:10.1016/j.vaccine.2021.02.009. PMID: 33610375.
